owner: Youssef Elmougy and Ling Liu, Georgia Institute of Technology
collection_method: fresh direct download from publisher-linked public Google Drive folder
license_name: not stated in publisher repository; legal review required
permitted_purpose: exploratory research and shadow evaluation only
quality_limits: The publisher repository does not state an explicit dataset license.
Publisher labels are not locally dual-reviewed gold labels.
Time is represented by 49 ordinal snapshots rather than exact event timestamps.
The dataset covers Bitcoin only and cannot support multichain claims.
Models and metrics must remain research/shadow-only until all promotion gates pass.
raw_data_policy: Raw files are git-ignored and must not be redistributed from this repository.
